entities.name: otel-demo/Deployment/cart
entities.reasoning: Cart pods entered CrashLoopBackOff due to OOMKilled, preventing the Service from serving traffic.
entities.evidence: Alert KubePodCrashLooping on cart pods, metric spikes in memory usage, logs showing OOMKilled.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/cart
entities.reasoning: Service became unavailable because its backing pods were unhealthy.
entities.evidence: ServiceDown alert triggered, Endpoint ready count 0, downstream 5xx alerts on frontend.

entities.name: otel-demo/Deployment/frontend
entities.reasoning: Frontend pods returned 5xx errors when calling the cart service.
entities.evidence: HighHTTP5xxRate alert on frontend, trace errors showing failed calls to cart service.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/frontend
entities.reasoning: User‑facing service showed degraded latency and error rate due to downstream cart failures.
entities.evidence: ServiceLatencyHigh and ServiceErrorRate alerts, traces indicating downstream errors.

propagations.condition: Pods repeatedly exited with OOMKilled causing CrashLoopBackOff

propagations.effect: Frontend pods generated 5xx responses to users

alerts_explained.explanation: Cart pods repeatedly crashed due to OOM, triggering CrashLoopBackOff.
Cart service lost all ready endpoints because its pods were unhealthy.
Frontend pods returned a high rate of 5xx errors caused by downstream cart failures.
Overall request latency increased due to retries and timeouts when calling cart.
